Suppose we wish to find a critical point of the function $f(x,y)$ in the region $[0,2]\times [0,2]⊆{R}^{2},$ where

$$
f(x,y)={x}^{2}y-2x-{y}^{2}+1.
$$

Calculate one iteration of the Newton-Raphson process for optimization that starts at ${x}_{0}=[1,\,1]^{T}.$ Round your final answer to three decimal places (if needed).
